description_en: Lists traffic control tasks that meet specified conditions
description_zh: 查询指定条件下的流量调控任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun pairecservice list-traffic-control-tasks --name task_1 --traffic-control-task-id 1 --scene-id 1 --environment Pre --status Running --biz-version Latest --control-target-filter All --sort-by GmtCreateTime --order ASC --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --all false --instance-id pairec-cn-00000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTrafficControlTasks

parameters.help_en: The name of the traffic control task
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the traffic control task
parameters.name: traffic_control_task_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scene. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2402581.html operation
parameters.name: scene_id

parameters.help_en:
The environment. Valid values:

- `Daily`: the daily environment

- `Pre`: the pre-production environment

- `Prod`: the production environment
parameters.help_zh:
运行环境。

- Daily-日常环境。

- Pre-预发环境。

- Prod-生产环境
parameters.name: environment

parameters.help_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

- `NotRunning`: The task is not running.

- `Ready`: The task is ready to run.

- `Running`: The task is running.

- `Finished`: The task is finished
parameters.help_zh:
状态。

- NotRunning：未运行。

- Ready：待运行。

- Running：运行中。

- Finished：已结束
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The version. Valid values:

- `Latest`: The latest version. This is the default value.

- `Released`: the released version
parameters.help_zh:
版本。

- Latest：最新版本，默认值

- Released：已发布版本
parameters.name: version

parameters.help_en:
The filter for traffic control targets. Valid values:

- `All`: Returns all traffic control targets.

- `Valid`: Returns only active traffic control targets. A traffic control target is active if the current time is within the specified start and end time.

- `None`: Does not return any traffic control targets
parameters.help_zh:
过滤流量调控目标。

- All：返回所有。

- Valid：返回有效的（开始结束时间段内是开启状态的）。

- None：不返回
parameters.name: control_target_filter

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the results. Valid values:

- `GmtCreateTime`: Sorts the results by creation time.

- `GmtModifiedTime`: Sorts the results by modification time
parameters.help_zh:
排序依据。
- GmtCreateTime：按创建时间排序。
- GmtModifiedTime-按更新时间排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `ASC`: ascending order

- `DESC`: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，取值：

- ASC：升序。
- DESC：降序
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return all results without pagination
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回所有数据(不分页)
parameters.name: all

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListInstances](https://icms.alibaba-inc.com/content/learn/pai?l=1\&m=16768\&n=4300782) operation
parameters.name: instance_id
